description: Agentic Finance: 500+ agent tools, multi-chain USDC over x402 or MPP, free via PoW or card credits
name: io.github.MikeyPetrillo/agent402

environmentVariables.description: Hex private key of a wallet funded with USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Monad, Celo, Avalanche, Sei, Optimism, Stellar or Algorand (or USDG on Robinhood Chain). Unset = proof-of-work mode (free pure-CPU tools).
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional hard cap on total USDC spent per session (e.g. 1.00). Refused before any payment is signed.
environmentVariables.name: AGENT402_BUDGET

environmentVariables.description: Optional max USD price for any single call (e.g. 0.01).
environmentVariables.name: AGENT402_MAX_PER_CALL

environmentVariables.description: Prepaid card-credits key (a402_...) from https://agent402.tools/credits. With it set and no wallet key, every tool pays by card; the list price is debited only on a successful call.
environmentVariables.name: AGENT402_CREDITS_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional base58 (or JSON byte-array) secret key of a Solana wallet funded with USDC on Solana.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_AGENT_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional: restrict and order the chains to pay on (e.g. "base,solana" or a CAIP-2 like eip155:4663).
environmentVariables.name: AGENT402_NETWORKS

title: Agent402.Tools: pay-per-call web tools
